pinned_by: the study's reproducibility build - alias pins and OpenRouter transport frozen at the Aug 1 pre-registration commit
routing_note: All paper-bound roles route via OpenRouter (https://openrouter.ai/api/v1). 'resolved' is the OpenRouter model slug (verified against GET /api/v1/models on 2026-07-29). 'route' is the provider-routing block llm() sends with every call ({"order": [...], "allow_fallbacks": false}); order=null means no provider constraint is sent, and the manifest records the served provider per call. price_usd_per_mtok are OpenRouter credit prices per Mtok at pin time. system_fingerprint is generally absent via OpenRouter: per_call.jsonl.gz records the OpenRouter generation id + returned model string per call instead, as the fingerprint fallback.

judge-primary.notes: the judge benchmark judge in all 8 grid cells + v14 arms + baselines; the salience few-shot arm/the external anchors/the reference-quality ablation judging; the k=8 recipe re-implementation uses this. Grid settings: temp 1.0, reasoning_effort none, max_tokens 1024. Empirical (2026-07-29 smoke probes): OpenRouter does NOT pass n through on this route (n=8 request returns 1 choice, charged once) - k=8 runs as 8 independent calls (k_impl=independent_calls, statistically equivalent); reasoning_effort IS honored (none -> reasoning_tokens 0); seed accepted; temperature accepted without error (OpenRouter lists no temperature support for this model - determinism measured empirically across the replicate runs).

auditor.notes: the ground-truth gate audit + semantic checks: reasoning_effort high, seeds fixed per the pre-registered audit design. Kept in the lock via OpenRouter: the pre-registered cross-family requirement keeps GPT-5.5 off the subscription transport, and the audit rates are paper-bound methods numbers.

author-offplan.notes: Authoring/verification/critic support only unless a pre-registered arm names it; reasoning_effort none unless that arm says otherwise. (Construction/verification work on Claude models stays on the subscription transport and never enters this lock.)

constructor.notes: the ground-truth gate construction model (repair / regen / severity rubric grades), the same model as the plan-path construction row (claude-opus-5) on a different transport: the OpenRouter API rather than the `claude` command line. Moved to the metered API on 2026-08-10. reasoning_effort medium (the plan path's --effort medium), temperature 1.0, max_tokens 16000. Instrument integrity: the auditor role and every pinned auditor setting are untouched, and every repaired/regenerated artefact is re-audited by the cross-family auditor regardless of how it was built. Slug + price verified against GET /api/v1/models on 2026-08-10 (context 1M, reasoning_effort supported).

judge-qwen.notes: the judge benchmark open-weights generality row; temp 1.0, max_tokens 1024. Slug verified 2026-07-29: OpenRouter names this exact model 'Qwen3 235B A22B Instruct 2507' (the -thinking-2507 variant is a different slug) - no substitution. Provider order deliberately left unpinned for this row - 12 providers serve this model (DeepInfra 0.09/0.55 is the model-level default price recorded here; Novita/Parasail/Alibaba/Nebius etc. differ) - so llm() sends no provider constraint and the manifest records the served provider per call. OpenRouter lists seed + temperature support; no reasoning params (non-thinking variant, as intended).

judge-gemini.notes: the judge benchmark SECOND-FAMILY replication row, added 2026-08-17: the two k=1 grid designs (F-bin-k1, FC-score-k1) re-run on a non-OpenAI family so the paper's central asymmetry does not rest on one judge family. Flagship pro-tier Gemini on OpenRouter at pin time (GET /api/v1/models 2026-08-17: gemini-2.5-pro and gemini-3.1-pro-preview are the only pro-tier text slugs; ~google/gemini-pro-latest is an alias onto the same price and is deliberately not pinned - a moving alias cannot back a paper number). temp 1.0, max_tokens 1024, same prompts, same substrate. reasoning_effort: DEVIATION FROM THE GRID, disclosed - the grid runs gpt-5.4 at effort 'none'; this endpoint refuses it outright (HTTP 400 'Reasoning is mandatory for this endpoint and cannot be disabled', probed 2026-08-17), so 'minimal' is the nearest available analogue and is what is pinned. Reasoning tokens are billed at the completion rate (pricing.internal_reasoning 0.000012) and are included in completion_tokens. Route pinned to google-vertex (Google AI Studio also serves it - excluded so the served stack is uniform); OpenRouter lists seed AND temperature support on both. Slug, price, provider list and the reasoning-effort refusal all verified live 2026-08-17.

judge-opus.notes: the judge benchmark second-frontier row: temp 1.0, max_tokens 1024; k=1 rows + the FC-score-k8 transfer cell. Via OpenRouter this satisfies the reproducibility regime's API-routing rule (never claude -p). Route pinned to Anthropic first-party (Bedrock/Vertex/Azure also serve it at the same price - deliberately excluded so the served stack is uniform). OpenRouter lists temperature but NOT seed for this route - seed is best-effort-absent here; the 3-run empirical sd is the reproducibility measure.
